messages:
claire: Heads-up from design review: Project > Compliance panel has three small but annoying issues we should fix this sprint: 1) retention dropdown focus jumps when you open region selector next, 2) the encryption badge copy is ambiguous (support keeps getting 'who holds my key' tickets), and 3) audit-log CSV export uses UTC but console shows local time which confuses customers. Can we align on fixes?

 tom: Repro for #1: tab into Retention, open the dropdown, press Tab to go to Region. Focus lands on the trigger but the expanded options collapse immediately. Happens on Chrome and Firefox.

 ines: Seems like the dropdown closes on blur because the trigger blurs before the list gets focus. Quick win: move options in DOM after the trigger and only close on Escape or explicit click-out. Also add role="listbox" and aria-activedescendant management so screen readers announce items.

 claire: Good. For copy (#2) here's what support reports: users read 'Managed key — Redwood' and assume Redwood can decrypt everything. Ops wants a short phrase that fits a single-line pill in settings list but is unambiguous.

 karen: Ops recommended two things: (A) pill text: 'Key owner: Redwood' or 'Key owner: Customer (BYOK)' and (B) make the pill a control that opens a modal explaining implications (rotation, revocation). Also add data-key-owner="redwood|customer" on the settings row for triage. Keep that attribute out of logs with key ids.

 ux-bot: Accessibility notes: small text on the pill at 12px fails WCAG when hovered (contrast ~3.7:1). Recommendation: raise font-weight to 600 or darken background to meet >=4.5:1 for small text. Also ensure keyboard focus ring is visible and the pill has aria-describedby pointing to a hidden explainer.

 ines: For the modal copy I drafted: "Who holds the encryption key? 'Redwood' means Redwood manages the master key; we can rotate/revoke on behalf of customers. 'Customer (BYOK)' means you supply and control the key; Redwood never has access to key material." Keep that text short and include a link "How keys work" to docs.

 tom: On audit log exports: current behavior = console converts row timestamps to user timezone but CSV is UTC. That breaks customer workflows. Two options: convert CSV to match console timezone OR mark CSV timestamps with explicit offset like '2025-11-01T14:23:00-07:00'. Ops prefers explicit offsets for auditability.

 karen: Support wants a UI hint when timezone differs: header 'Timestamp (Your timezone: PDT)' and tooltip with full name + offset + a 'Export as UTC' toggle. Also add a small copy in export dialog: 'Timestamps in CSV use ISO with offset for clarity.'

 ux-bot: Quick keyboard-flow suggestion for the region picker: when focus moves from retention dropdown to region trigger via Tab, programmatically move focus into the first option if the list is open. Otherwise ensure the trigger keeps aria-expanded="true" until list has focus.

 ops-bot: Security checklist: data-key-owner attribute is okay if it only contains owner enum (redwood|customer). Ensure telemetry retention = 90 days and strip any KMS identifiers. Also flag: any change logs that include key owner transitions need to be audited and kept per compliance (exportable).

 claire: Plan: tom/ines implement a11y + DOM reorder + blur behavior; tom update pill styles and aria-describedby; ines wire up modal copy and docs link; karen update support playbook with data-key-owner and export guidance; ux-bot will add voiceover notes to component README. Can we aim for PRs by EOD Thursday?

 tom: Yup, I'll push a small PR: reorder DOM, add role/listbox, fix blur-close, add aria-describedby, and adjust contrast. Will attach before/after screenshots and VoiceOver notes.

 ines: I'll draft modal copy and the short inline tooltip (accessible) and add tests for keyboard navigation.

 karen: I'll update support templates and confirm telemetry retention window with infra.

 claire: Great — thanks everyone. Quick follow-ups in the PR: include measurement screenshots for contrast ratios, and include a test case that verifies CSV export includes offset in ISO string. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
